pick.name: GitHub Actions
pick.why: Free unlimited minutes on public repos (open-core) + 2,000/mo private; biggest action ecosystem; Claude Code writes it fluently
pick.free_limits: Free plan: 2,000 min/mo private, 500 MB artifacts, 10 GB cache/repo; public repos and self-hosted runners free; Linux 2-core $0.006/min; planned $0.002/min self-hosted fee was postponed (Dec 2025); Copilot code review consumes minutes

candidates.verdict: Fine but you live on GitHub

decision: GitHub Actions is the default: free on public repos, 2,000 min/mo on private repos, largest action ecosystem. Add a self-hosted runner on any cheap VM only if private-repo minutes run out (self-hosted runners currently carry no GitHub charge).
details: Pin third-party actions to commit SHAs (see Trivy incident in security slot).
